prompt:
A desktop e-commerce homepage for SidePlay, a sports and play equipment store in Lebanon, rendered edge to edge as a finished website screen with crisp, readable text; no browser window, device or desk around it.

The visitor's job: find the gear, see its price, and order it in one WhatsApp message to 71 904 725. What leads is a running track seen from above: seven red tartan lanes sweep in a wide curve across the first screen, with white lane lines and big white lane numbers, and every lane is a department with its count and starting price painted in it: 1 Rackets 23 items from $8, 2 Fitness 35 items from $6, 3 Basketball 24 items from $25, 4 Goals & Yard 32 items from $9, 5 Game Tables 7 items from $220, 6 Ride 33 items from $10, 7 Outdoor 20 items from $9. On the white infield inside the curve: the headline "GEAR FOR EVERY GAME.", the line "174 items, prices on the page. Order in one WhatsApp message.", a search field "What are you playing?" with a red Find button, and three featured products on white cards with their photos and prices: aluminium scooter $150, adjustable basketball stand $525, Fusiontec tennis racket $50, each with a red "Order on WhatsApp" button. Below, the start of the product grid titled "THE SHOP".

Frame: the SidePlay logo (SP monogram with speed lines, SIDE in silver, PLAY in red) top left on a small black plate, department links, a red "WhatsApp 71 904 725" button at the right.

Visual law: red tartan track and crisp white lines and white paper as the ground, black only in small accents (the logo plate, prices). Heavy extended italic uppercase headlines like the logo lettering. Bright outdoor daylight; no dark backgrounds.
